channel.title: Loadout Rank: new AI releases
channel.description: Notable AI tool and model releases, each linked to its primary source.

item.title: Reflection: Beam 1.0 (open weights, Apache 2.0)
item.description: Reflection's first open-weight model: a 501B-total / 23B-active MoE with a 1M-token context, built for coding, reasoning and agentic work. Weights in BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 on Hugging Face; also on Reflection's API and partners including Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter and OpenCode.

item.title: Black Forest Labs: FLUX 3 Image Klein (open weights)
item.description: A 5.6B-parameter open-weight image model for text-to-image, editing and multi-reference generation (up to 10 reference images), with native 4K output and bounding-box layout control. Weights on Hugging Face under the FLUX Kommunity License; also on the BFL API.

item.title: Krea: Krea 3
item.description: Krea's new image-editing model for production work: most edits return in under 8 seconds at native 2K, with characters and products kept consistent across references. Live on krea.ai and via fal, Replicate, OpenRouter, Together AI and others.

item.title: OpenAI: GPT-Live-1.1 (ChatGPT Voice)
item.description: Updated voice model for ChatGPT Voice with more natural accents and new voices in French, German, Hindi, Japanese, Korean and Mexican Spanish. Availability varies by region and account.

item.title: Meta: Muse Spark Open (open weights)
item.description: Meta's open-weight multimodal MoE: 816B total / 42B active parameters, 1M-token context, built for coding and agentic work. Weights on Hugging Face; runs locally on M5 Ultra Mac Studios via MLX, plus vLLM, SGLang and llama.cpp; hosted on OpenRouter, Groq, Together and others.

item.title: NVIDIA: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt
item.description: Open models for agents: Super VL (120B) for servers, Bolt 74B-A9B sized for 24GB local machines with llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio and vLLM support. A 4GB Bolt E4B is due Oct 23.

item.title: Anthropic: Code Review GA for Claude Team and Enterprise
item.description: Automated GitHub pull-request reviews leave research preview; most finish in 6-10 minutes, with Quick, Standard or Deep settings per repo. Eligible Enterprise orgs can claim credits through Jan 15, 2027.

item.title: Google: Deep Review (public release)
item.description: Agentic system that checks technical documents (papers, Docs, slides) for grounded, rigorous feedback. Two free reviews per week; heavier use via your Gemini API key.

item.title: Google: Gemini 4 Argon
item.description: Google's latest frontier model, aimed at hard coding, science and agentic work with a 1M-token limit. Available via API, Antigravity (Ultra), and the Gemini app (Ultra/Pro). Intro price $2/$10 per 1M tokens until Nov 30.

item.title: Anthropic: Claude Haiku 5.5
item.description: Anthropic's cheapest, fastest small model. Sonnet 5.5 cache reads also halved in price, and Max/Team plans get monthly API credits.

item.title: OpenAI: GPT-6 with Intelligent UI in ChatGPT
item.description: GPT-6 Sol (paid) and Luna (Free/Go) arrive in ChatGPT Chat, answering with interactive UIs. Rollout to paid tiers started Oct 7, Free/Go the next day.

item.title: OpenAI: dots (cloud-computer agents)
item.description: Always-on personal agents rolling out in ChatGPT to Pro and Business Premium users in eligible markets.

item.title: Anthropic: Claude Opus 5.5
item.description: First of the Claude 5.5 family: long-running agentic coding and knowledge work, $4/$20 per 1M tokens, 1M context. Fast mode available in Claude Code.

item.title: xAI (SpaceXAI): Grok 4.7
item.description: Flagship for coding and knowledge work; 500k context, $2/$6 per 1M tokens on the API. Available in Cursor and Grok Build.

item.title: OpenAI: Agents API (public beta)
item.description: Brings the Codex harness and infrastructure to developers via API; pay only for tokens and tools used.

item.title: Meta: Muse personal agent
item.description: Meta's personal AI agent for everyday tasks, in a Muse app, WhatsApp and the web. Date per secondary coverage; link is AP News.
